metadata.description: Red tiles form a stylized Ukrainian tryzub with a central spear and interwoven side prongs. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Alternating side bays surround the motif, with braided channels along the lower route. 3 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 6 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
